title: Default rooms: an admin role with canKick for the creator
description: Promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok in Mark's email of 2026-11-18 (IETF notes/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-sent.md). Soon after. mimid-agent's default room policy gives members no canKick, so removing another user needs the operator (mimid admin remove|ban). Add an admin role (canKick and the usual admin capabilities) assigned to the room creator; keep members as they are.
